subject: M2-C-027 + M2-C-029 / P13 — rewritePaths has two unguarded string preconditions
why: A trailing '/' on oldPrefix silently rewrites NOTHING; an empty newPrefix silently produces leading-slash (absolute-looking) paths. Bare String parameters, three call sites that happen to be well-behaved, and no diagnostic in either direction.

subject: M2-A-16 — 'node ids MUST be unique within a forest'
why: Falsified as a requirement by P14; replace with the true clause — TreeWalk is deliberately agnostic to id uniqueness.

subject: M2-A-20 — 'MUST stay allocation-simple and recursive'
why: A style preference I dressed as an intent clause, included in Phase 3 as a deliberate specimen. It behaved as advertised.

subject: M2-C-036 — the walkers' stack-overflow depth is unguarded and environment-dependent
why: The ratchet's #2 pick and one of only two claims with no test at all; does a depth guard belong here, or is unbounded depth a real invariant of the binder?

subject: M2-C-034 — 'unbounded recursion with no depth guard' as a pinned claim
why: A description of an ABSENCE. Ratified, it forbids ever adding a depth guard — which R09 may conclude is wanted.

subject: M2-B-01 — TreeWalk is the TEST SUITE's oracle, not only production's
why: 12 of 13 test files use it as a fixture helper; a regression here makes assertions across Store/Canvas/Inbox/MCP report on a lie.

subject: M2-C-019 — a collected node carries its ENTIRE unfiltered subtree
why: 36 call sites depend on it, it is almost certainly intended, and nobody has ever written it down.

subject: M1-C-024 / P09 — a CRLF card loses every field
why: Swift's \r\n grapheme cluster defeats split(separator:"\n"); a Windows-touched card parses as one line and kind/swatches/senses/images all come back empty.

subject: The eleven undocumented preconditions behind 'editor-reachable'
why: M1-A-01's escape hatch carries eleven conditions that appear in no comment, no test and no type; either document them or make PaletteCard.init validating.

subject: M1-C-021 — an empty 'kind:' value consumes the one-shot capture
why: The one-shot rule exists to stop body prose corrupting kind (M1-T-039); here it fires on a line carrying no information.

subject: M1-C-023 — a writer-typed blank line before 'kind:' is silently eaten
why: Narrows M1-A-04, a rule four dedicated tests are devoted to; a blank-LOOKING line with a space in it survives, which is the tell.

subject: M1-C-003 / P03 — color(fromHex:) accepts '#+FFFFF'
why: UInt32(_:radix:) accepts a leading '+' and the length check counts it; this is the SOLE gate on which swatches enter the model.

subject: M1-C-016 — an INDENTED '## Swatches' still opens a section
why: Indentation is the natural thing a writer tries after hitting the documented heading-in-body residual, and it does not work.

subject: M1-C-046 — a remote URL in imagePaths is mangled by relativize
why: The parser is careful never to ADMIT a remote URL (M1-A-06); the renderer will happily emit one and collapse its scheme's '//'.

subject: M1-C-044 + M1-C-045 — a newline in title or note silently loses data
why: Title's remainder migrates into body; a note truncates at the newline. Same root question as R04: validate at init, or document as unreachable.

subject: M1-T-030 — 'a string with non-hex digits returns nil'
why: My extraction generalised a single assertion about '#GGGGGG' into a false universal; rewrite the claim to match the test, and let R03 carry the defect.

subject: M2-C-010 / P14 — find returns the FIRST pre-order match among duplicates
why: 42 call sites; held over 20,000 forests with deliberately duplicated ids.

subject: M2-C-018 / P10 — collect descends through a failing parent
why: The single most load-bearing property of the second-most-called walker; held over 20,000 forests.

subject: M1-C-041 — template and render disagree on bytes
why: A new card changes bytes on its first save with no edit; harmless until any content-hash, sync or git-facing feature exists.

subject: M2-T-023 + M2-T-024 — the rewrite claims as I extracted them
why: True only for separator-free prefixes; neither my claim nor the doc comment carries the qualifier. Fix the code (R02) or add the precondition.

subject: M1-C-043 — an invalid swatch is written to the file, then silently lost
why: Asymmetric with the untagged-empty-note case (M1-T-042), which the renderer DOES skip; the file is written either way.

subject: M2-C-035 — idsByPath's ITERATION order is not stable across processes
why: The doc comment resolves the INSERTION contest and is silent on iteration; a caller that iterates rather than subscripts has a run-varying order.

subject: M1-C-040 + M1-C-042 — an exact render byte-string and an enum declaration order
why: M1-C-042 should probably RATIFY (M1-B-04: the phone depends on the order); M1-C-040 is the brittle-pin specimen. Split them.

subject: M2-C-012 + M2-C-013 — mutate and remove apply to EVERY match
why: With a duplicated root id, remove empties the forest; tripwire 23 records that a mint collision has already happened once in this codebase.

subject: M1-A-20 — 'MUST NOT admit an invalid swatch into a rendered file'
why: Falsified by M1-C-043; I flagged it LOW and predicted its death in Phase 3. Kill the clause; R11 carries the real question.
